### Analyst Strategic Outlook & Execution Risks
1.  **The "Gas-Lock" Bottleneck:** The PDP8 domestic gas pipeline (~6,900 MW across Ô Môn, Miền Trung, and Dung Quất) is entirely paralyzed by upstream O&G delays. PVN and international partners (ExxonMobil, Murphy Oil) have struggled to reach Final Investment Decision (FID) on the Block B and Blue Whale (Cá Voi Xanh) fields due to pricing and tax disputes. Until upstream FID occurs, these thermal CODs remain theoretical.
2.  **LNG Infrastructure & PPA Hurdles:** The 23,900 MW LNG pipeline faces a "chicken-and-egg" problem. Developers (like AES at Sơn Mỹ or BOT sponsors) require bankable PPAs and government guarantees to finance LNG import terminals, but EVN/MOIT are hesitant to sign take-or-pay USD-denominated PPAs without grid absorption certainty and pass-through tariff mechanisms. 
3.  **Coal Phase-Out Reality:** The PDP8 "Watchlist" (Table 3) coal projects are effectively dead capital. International export credit agencies (ECAs) and multilateral banks have ceased coal financing. Unless domestic sponsors (or state-backed entities) absorb the capital expenditure, projects like Sông Hậu 2 and Vĩnh Tân 3 will likely be formally cancelled or converted to LNG in the upcoming PDP8 Implementation Plan revisions.
